title: 15+ Hollywood Movies That Criticise Religion
description:
Hollywood has never shied away from questioning faith, gods, and religious institutions. In this video, we explore the best movies that criticise religion, from powerful dramas like There Will Be Blood and The Magdalene Sisters to satirical masterpieces like Religulous and The Invention of Lying.

We’ll dive into films such as The Golden Compass, Agora, Creation, Kumare, The Rapture, and many more that challenge blind faith, hypocrisy, and dogma. Whether it’s satire, drama, or documentary, these movies offer fearless critiques of belief systems and invite you to think critically about religion’s place in society.

👉 Watch till the end to discover hidden gems like Hug an Atheist and No Dinosaurs in Heaven.
